quizName:
Hardest Questions in Minnesota
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means you cannot do that action. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Yield the right-of-way to other traffic. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: When you see a school bus stopped with its stop arm out, what should you do?

options.text: Stop completely and wait before going.
Honk your horn and pass the bus on the left.
Keep driving when you think the children are done leaving.
Pass the bus before the door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and wait before going.
questions.explanation: You must stop your car when a school bus has its stop arm out. Do not move until the arm goes down.

questions.question: When should you slow down?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, at intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, on curves, where there are people, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.

questions.explanation: Drivers must pay full attention to the road. Any extra activity takes your focus away and can cause a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means you cannot do that action. You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: Construction work zone signs are orange.
questions.explanation: Most work zone signs are orange and diamond-shaped. Some are rectangular. These signs are reflective so you can see them at night.

questions.question: What should you do when you approach railroad tracks?

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate comes down.
Do not worry about how many tracks to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop at railroad crossings.

questions.question: You miss your exit on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.
questions.explanation: Do not back up on a freeway or shoulder. Continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.

questions.question: What can harm your ability to drive safely?
questions.explanation: Alcohol, drugs, and tiredness all make driving unsafe. You must be in good condition to drive safely.

questions.question: You had a stressful incident at work and feel angry. When you get to your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly to distract yourself.
Drive fast on the interstate to release your anger.
Wait a few minutes to calm down before driving home.
Stop at a bar for drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait a few minutes to calm down before driving home.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, wait before you drive. Driving while emotional is dangerous for you and other drivers on the road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always use your signal, even if no other cars are nearby.
Use your signal only if other cars are visible.
Use your signal only at night.
Use your signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always use your signal, even if no other cars are nearby.
questions.explanation: Always signal when you turn, change lanes, or pull away from the curb. Make signaling a habit, not an option.

questions.question: When stopped by police for a traffic violation or equipment check, you must show:
questions.explanation: You must carry and show your license, registration, and proof of insurance. These are required documents in your vehicle.

questions.question: You cannot park:
questions.explanation: There are many places where parking is not allowed. These include in front of mailboxes, in front of driveways, in tunnels, and on bridges.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver is driving too close behind you, you should:

options.text: Get out of the aggressive driver's way.
Look at the driver as he or she passes.
Speed up as he or she is passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out of the aggressive driver's way.
questions.explanation: If you see an aggressive driver, move out of their way. Do not make eye contact. Speeding up may anger them more and create danger.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or a crash.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
This lane is reserved for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol hurts your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend. You should:

options.text: Not worry about it because all vehicles are the same.
Not tell your friend that you are unfamiliar with the vehicle.
Ignore any problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes before driving to learn where all the vehicle's controls and equipment are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes before driving to learn where all the vehicle's controls and equipment are.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar vehicle, spend a few minutes learning the location and operation of the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear selector, and horn. Fix any problems before you drive.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers the direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: Every motor vehicle in Minnesota must have liability insurance.
questions.explanation: You must carry proof of insurance in your vehicle at all times. If you cannot show proof of insurance to a police officer, your driver license and vehicle registration may be suspended.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means parking is not allowed.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers they may see traffic coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle with sirens and flashing lights approaches, you should pull to the right edge of the road and let it pass.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with lights and/or sirens approaches, pull to the right side of the road immediately and let it pass.

questions.question: Drivers should maintain a safe distance when driving near a cyclist.
questions.explanation: Drivers must be careful around cyclists and keep a safe distance between their vehicle and the cyclist.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts drivers that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red light, proceed on a green light, or watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: Who must use seat belts?
questions.explanation: Keep seat belts clean and in good condition. Everyone in the vehicle must use them. Minnesota law requires all vehicles to have seat belts, and drivers must use them.

questions.question: What should you do when you meet an aggressive driver?

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Show them you disapprove of their driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and create distance between your car and theirs. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or make rude gestures.

questions.question: What should you do after a serious crash?
questions.explanation: Move your vehicle off the road and stop if possible. Call 911 if anyone is injured and help them. Report the crash to police if there is an injury, a death, or more than $1,000 in property damage.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?

options.text: It makes you feel too confident.

questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time and hurts your balance and coordination. Your vision and ability to judge distance get worse, making it hard to react safely.

questions.question: What should you do before turning?
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal three to four seconds before you turn.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on green must wait for oncoming cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on green must wait for oncoming cars.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left on a green light, they do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to clear.

questions.question: Cell phones can distract drivers and cause crashes.
questions.explanation: Do not use cell phones, computers, or other devices while driving. Only use your phone to report a crash or emergency. Keep all your attention on the road.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means no right turn is permitted.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.
